text:
marta_csm: FYI - Flagging Crestview account. Renewal in ~7w and their prod calls dropped ~75% overnight. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/crestview
metrics-bot: ALERT: crestview-prod request volume -75% (24h). No 5xx spike. Top affected: /embed-batch, /rerank.
kevin_se: Customer support ticket shows they rolled a client-side change to route embedding calls to an in-house vector store on 2026-03-12. Attached config snippet in ticket.
sophie_sales: On commercial calls they mentioned evaluating Halcyon Labs this quarter. I captured a note in SFDC (pilot active).
arjun_eng: Checked infra 03:00 - 05:00 UTC window1 there were no deploys or infra alerts. Token spend down but latency profiles unchanged for the remaining traffic.
marta_csm: That suggests partial migration + competitor pilot. We should treat this as elevated renewal risk. Proposed short plan: quick health sync, small cost/latency brief, offer a timeboxed Dedicated credit, and tech workshop to demo migration/backstop.
sophie_sales: Sales suggests: 4-week Dedicated trial credit (metered), joint tech session, and an exec-level ROI note. If they run Halcyon, propose an A/B where routing preserves SLOs on our endpoints.
arjun_eng: I can prepare a 30m "migration backstop" tech session showing routing fallbacks, prefix-KV caching, and cost controls. Available Thu 9am PT. Also will draft a minimal runbook for reverting client routing.
kevin_se: I'll attach the screenshots and the client's new routing config to the support ticket and mark as high priority. They also reported a small mismatch in embedding vector dims during the switch; might be a config bug.
marta_csm: Sophie - can you surface whether procurement has an embargo window? We need decision timing for the credit offer.
sophie_sales: Procurement said Q2 close for budget owners, but they might decide faster for a pilot. I'll try to get exact dates.
ops-bot: NOTE: Billing hold requires formal request and finance approval. Use /billing/hold-request with reason + affected keys.
claire_finance: If they ask to pause charges we require: written request from customer, evidence of migration, and PO/contract note. We can accelerate review but need these docs.
marta_csm: Action items: Sophie - confirm procurement timing and thread back; Arjun - prepare tech session + runbook; Kevin - attach config evidence & check embedding dim mismatch; Marta - prepare short cost + SLO brief and draft credit wording.
arjun_eng: Will upload deck and runbook to /shared/cs/crestview by Wed EOD.
kevin_se: Evidence uploaded to ticket #4321. Also logged a small data-shape warning for embeddings; follow-up with their ML lead recommended.
sophie_sales: I'll draft the credit offer text and propose tying it to completion of the joint tech session and a migration checklist.
marta_csm: Setting renewal risk = "elevated" now. If usage drops further or they confirm Halcyon pilot is production, escalate to "high" and request billing hold evidence.
claire_finance: Understood. Keep finance looped before any hold requests.
marta_csm: I'll reach out to their ML lead for a quick check-in and send an invite for Thu 9am PT. Please post any pre-reads in this thread.
sophie_sales: Invite out to their ML lead (Ravi) and procurement (Lina). Added meeting agenda + pre-reads.
kevin_se: Recommend capturing a short A/B test plan in the meeting so we can show measurable latency & cost delta. I'll bring sample traffic patterns.
arjun_eng: Agree. We'll include a small controlled A/B template in the runbook.
marta_csm: Thanks everyone 0 please update this thread after the session.
